_README: KEITH'S POSTED FIGURES — the human half of the calibration loop.
_WHY_THIS_FILE_EXISTS: MEASURED 2026-07-16: all four vendors are UI-ONLY for spend. Google has NO spend method in ANY Cloud Billing API version (checked the discovery doc — the authoritative contract: v1 = CRUD+IAM, v1beta/v2beta = SKU price catalog only, v1beta1/v2 = 404); BigQuery export is the only documented path. Anthropic's /v1/organizations/usage_report/messages is Console-org/API-key only, NOT Max/Cowork. xAI's /v1/api-key returns 200 but key metadata only (/v1/usage|billing|credits = 404). M365 Copilot is consumer-licence; Graph is enterprise-only. NOTHING CAN BE POLLED. So Keith reads the page and posts the number, and that number is the ONLY ground truth these pools have.
_HOW_TO_UPDATE: Edit a block and re-run _run_meters.bat. Always set posted_at. If a figure is unknown, DELETE the block — do NOT guess. An absent pool renders grey 'no data', which is honest; a guessed pool is the $299-phantom failure again.
